name: WARNING: Sushi Bar Shrimp Tempura Roll (Deep-Fried Batter, Eel Sauce & Mayo)
whyItWorks: Shrimp coated in wheat batter and deep-fried in commercial fryer oil, rolled inside white rice and nori with sweet sauce. The combination of fryer oil, tough nori, and high-fat sauces triggers dumping and delayed gastric distress.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Avoid tempura fried rolls. Choose boiled shrimp (Ebi) nigiri for clean, unbattered seafood.
